videos.title: How to Tie a Timber Hitch — Scouting America
videos.value: Shows the full tying motion — pass, tuck, twist, snug — that a Scout needs to see once before the timber hitch's quick-tie/quick-release pattern makes sense

videos.title: How to Tie a Clove Hitch — Scouting America
videos.value: Shows the wrap-cross-wrap-tuck motion in real time, including how both ends are pulled together to tighten, which a written sequence can't fully convey

videos.title: How to Tie the Square Lashing — AnimatedKnots
videos.value: Demonstrates the full alternating over-under wrap pattern and frapping turns for joining right-angle poles, timing that a still image can't carry

videos.title: How to Tie a Shear Lashing — Scouting America
videos.value: Shows the loose parallel wraps and frapping turns needed for poles that must still pivot at the lashing point, such as tripod legs

videos.title: How to Tie a Diagonal Lashing — Scouting America
videos.value: Shows the initial timber hitch pulling two non-touching poles together before the crossing wraps and frapping turns, a step easy to miss in text alone

videos.title: Bandages for Sprained Ankle, Head, Upper Arm, Collarbone — Scouting America
videos.value: Demonstrates the figure-eight wrapping motion from toe to ankle from the official Scouting America source, showing overlap and tension a still image can't carry

videos.title: How to do Compression-Only CPR — American Red Cross
videos.value: Shows hand placement, body position, and compression rate and depth from an authoritative safety source, a rhythm and pressure that words alone can't convey
